note: Data wave 2 (25 Nov 2026): AU/NZ course types read on the provider's own pages.

courses.name: Remote Emergency Care (REC), CRANAplus
courses.format: Two-day face-to-face workshop with online pre-learning: guided discussions, skill stations and scenarios for initial emergency care in remote settings.
courses.notes: CRANAplus is the peak body for the remote and isolated health workforce. Sessions are listed with a start date only; the end date is worked out from the stated workshop length.

courses.name: Maternity Emergency Care (MEC), CRANAplus
courses.format: Two-day face-to-face workshop with online pre-learning on maternity emergencies in remote settings, for non-midwife practitioners.
courses.notes: CRANAplus is the peak body for the remote and isolated health workforce. Sessions are listed with a start date only; the end date is worked out from the stated workshop length.

courses.name: Midwifery Upskilling (MIDUS), CRANAplus
courses.format: Two and a half day workshop plus 8 hours of pre-learning for midwives and medical officers giving maternity care in remote settings.

formatEvidence.quote: Time : 2 and a half day workshop + 8 hours pre-learning

courses.notes: CRANAplus is the peak body for the remote and isolated health workforce. Sessions are listed with a start date only; the end date is worked out from the stated workshop length.

courses.name: Paediatric Emergency Care and Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PEC+PALS), CRANAplus
courses.format: Two and a half day workshop plus pre-learning on paediatric emergencies and paediatric advanced life support in remote settings.

formatEvidence.quote: Time : 2 and a half day workshop + pre-learning

courses.notes: CRANAplus is the peak body for the remote and isolated health workforce. Sessions are listed with a start date only; the end date is worked out from the stated workshop length.

courses.name: Advanced Remote Emergency Care and Advanced Life Support (AREC+ALS), CRANAplus
courses.format: Two and a half day workshop plus pre-learning, for health professionals who have completed REC (or equivalent).

formatEvidence.quote: Time : 2 and a half day workshop + pre-learning

courses.notes: CRANAplus is the peak body for the remote and isolated health workforce. Sessions are listed with a start date only; the end date is worked out from the stated workshop length.

courses.name: Advanced Newborn Life Support (ANLS), CRANAplus
courses.format: Online pre-learning and quiz, then a one-day face-to-face workshop.

formatEvidence.quote: Time : Online pre-learning and quiz, followed by a one-day face-to-face workshop. Total learning time: 12 hours, equivalent to 12 CPD hours.
